name: Katie Linnet
source:
The most chill member of the trio, Katie doesn't share the rest of the group's love for material things. She's happy to run her own coffee shop, skate, and smoke her worries away. She does, however, share their interest in large "equipment".

[from [url=https://demondeals.org/characters]official site[/url]]
